method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Plain blocks on a flat field; plan's plate, parallels and vise missing; smaller framing overstates the source.
notes.fix: Bars on parallels on a granite plate in a shop; files as a count of fewer blanks.

notes.problem: Bars on flat felt, no world; cut share reads as part of the bar; blown highlight.
notes.fix: Physical cartridges in a studio sweep with the cut ones pulled into a dim pile; lower the key.

notes.problem: Primitive blocks on a flat field read as a 3D bar chart; volume bar highlight blown.
notes.fix: Granite plate and parallels at a lower camera, key down a stop on the volume bar, ghost edge refraction.

notes.problem: Out-of-focus panels, flat mat, luggage-tag tag.
notes.fix: Hard warm door light across the bench, engine soft behind, wired safety tag on the root.

notes.problem: Primitive blade, blurry panels, dead floor.
notes.fix: Close macro running off the left edge, true fir tree root, a flaw at the probe, dark bench backdrop.

notes.problem: Blade flat on a featureless mat in the bottom third; blank hangar slabs; stick-like borescope; price-tag tag.
notes.fix: Bench edge camera, foam tray filling half the frame, gloved hand with lit borescope tip, door light as rim.

notes.problem: Split composition, cropped engine, type on a wash, grating stripe.
notes.fix: Engine and stand fill half the frame with cases at its foot in one pool; narrow the doorway.

notes.problem: Split composition with no single dominant subject at feed size.
notes.fix: Engine in the door light with the apron as rim, cases forward into the light pool.

notes.problem: Gold squiggle wire over the cubes reads as a worm and adds a second accent meaning.
notes.fix: Delete the squiggle; light the last gold cube as the focal point.

notes.problem: Bare gradient sweep with thin contact, product shot in a void.
notes.fix: Contact-hardening shadows and worn floor under feet and cases, lower camera.

notes.problem: The 4 of 480 renders thin and outlined beside the bold 80.
notes.fix: Force lining figures or the same weight for headline numerals and re-render.

notes.problem: Accent dropped, grey pills, red Lubbock, low cast fraction.
notes.fix: Accent markers and pills, lower side key for shadows.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
